entities.summary: Bradley Joseph Thompson is an American sports commentator and former professional baseball pitcher who is a telecast analyst for the St. Louis Cardinals of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in MLB for the Cardinals and Kansas City Royals from 2005 to 2010, winning the World Series in 2006.
